footnotes_as_printed.a: n is the number of duplicate runs.
footnotes_as_printed.c: The phi_v's were calculated by using the equation of state of Harr, Gallagher, and Kell for rho_0.

pressure_note: P per row in MPa, 0.1013 MPa = 1 atm; pressure maintained with a back-pressure regulator and measured with an in-line McDaniel test gauge, accuracy approximately 0.3 MPa; nominal set pressures 0.1013, 10.38, 17.13, ~31, ~40 MPa with actual values printed

value.what: density difference of solution minus pure water, Delta rho = rho - rho_0, directly measured (reference: degassed distilled deionized water at the same T and P, density rho_0 from the Haar-Gallagher-Kell equation of state)

composition.other_species: degassed distilled deionized water; one salt per block (NaCl, MgCl2, KCl, NaBr, LiCl, CaCl2), no other species. Concentrations determined volumetrically to 0.1 %.

extra_unmapped: Delta/ppm (residual of measured Delta rho minus the fitted Delta rho, derived from authors' fit)
phi_v (cm3 mol-1) (apparent molar volume calculated by the authors; moved from value2 because the builder reads value2 as absolute density)
notes: Table printed as two column groups on each of two pages (p. 46 and 47); stacked in reading order, left column then right column per page, so block D (NaBr) continues at the top of p. 47 and block B (MgCl2) ends at the top of the right column of p. 46. Blocks E (LiCl) and F (CaCl2) are on p. 47; the right column of p. 47 first finishes LiCl (two rows) then gives CaCl2. LiCl is outside the six-ion set and NaBr as well; rows kept (builder decides).
